title: Antigravity CLI (agy) live PTY OSC retinting hook
description: Theme hook discovering running agy processes across /proc/<pid>/fd PTYs and retinting via OSC escape sequences without restarting.

title: Theme chooser Ctrl+R roll and Ctrl+W wallpaper cycler integration
description: Customized Quickshell ImagePicker with Ctrl+R (Roll Theme) and Ctrl+W (Cycle Matched Wallpaper) hotkeys.

title: Wallpaper matching via wallpaper-api CIEDE2000 and Wallhaven fallback
description: Matches high-res wallpapers using perceptual CIEDE2000 ΔE distances with automatic Wallhaven public fallback.

title: Dynamic theme generation and random rolls from paletty.dev
description: Fetches palettes from paletty.dev and offline catalog, generates Omarchy colors.toml and Hyprland border gradients.
